Saint John's University football coach John Gagliardi breaks Eddie Robinson's record of 408 career coaching victories to become college football 's all-time winningest coach with 409 wins.

피터 리드 was sacked after eight months as manager of 리즈 유나이티드, who were bottom of the Premier League after losing 8 of their opening 12 games. Long-serving coach and former manager 에디 그레이 took over on a temporary basis.
Prominent British footballer Jody Morris , who plays for 리즈 유나이티드 , is charged with rape .
UEFA : The final five qualifying countries for the 2004 European Football Championship are settled, with Latvia astonishingly defeating Turkey 3–2 on aggregate over two games.
Manager Rinus Israël leaves ADO Den Haag and moves to Al Wahda in the United Arab Emirates . Lex Schoenmaker is his successor in The Hague .
In an Asian Cup qualifier between Iran and Lebanon , 알리 다이 scores his 85th goal for the Iranian national team, breaking the record of Hungarian legend Ferenc Puskás .

첼시 lead the Premier League, one point ahead of 아스널 and four points ahead of 맨체스터 유나이티드. Debt-ridden Leeds propped up the top flight, joined in the relegation zone by 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 에버턴. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 노리치 시티 were top of Division One, followed by 셰필드 유나이티드, 입스위치 타운, 위건 애슬레틱 and Reading.
